gallery_marker_soft-body.name: Gallery Marker — Soft Body
gallery_marker_soft-body.description: Small bronze pedestal + glowing stake + Label3D reading SOFT BODY. Single-cell sub-gallery anchor used 24x across softbodies maps. Shared scene at commons/artifacts/gallery_marker; the lookup_name fixes the label.
gallery_marker_soft-body.capacity: POINTS the player at a softbodies sub-gallery
gallery_marker_soft-body.qfep_connection: a you-are-here anchor: bronze pedestal, glowing stake, a name in the air. Wayfinding furniture, never dominant — it marks the inhabited gallery without asserting content of its own.

dna.default: mode=stake - the shipped code path, so existing placements are unchanged
dna.was: the gallery_marker family shares request_note's attachment axis: how a sign meets the world it points at. It was billboarding in mid-air
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 — the axis was already in the script and the registry had never been told, so the sweep could not reach it

flex_cloth_pad.name: Flex Cloth Pad
flex_cloth_pad.description: Hanging cloth simulated as spring-mass vertices. The integration phase affordance: the bracelet's flex/drape mode nudges the cloth and watches it settle.

spring_lattice.description: The soft-bodies seam. A jelly is an elastic continuum - infinitely divisible, smooth under any load. The machine cannot integrate a continuum; it replaces it with a finite mesh of point masses on springs. Left: the true smooth blob. Right: the same blob as a mass-spring lattice - a faceted polygon at a chosen resolution; stiffen the springs past the timestep and it detonates. The smoothness was lattice resolution in disguise.
spring_lattice.name: Spring Lattice
spring_lattice.qfep_connection: A station in the bias landscape (doc/SEAM_PER_SEQUENCE.md); the digital-bias seam for softbodies. Bias is conserved; show the seam.
